app.title: 金龍ラーメン専用アプリ

auth.title: Log in
auth.displayName: Name (as written in the shift table)
auth.resetSent: Email sent. Please open the link in the email.
auth.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation email. Open the link in it, then log in.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: You can use the app after a manager approves you. Please enter your name.

rejected.title: Your request was declined
rejected.body: Please check with a manager. You can also apply again.

privacy.title: About your personal data
privacy.body1: Records in this app (meeting records and patrol checks) are used to improve customer service and to keep track of patrol time.
privacy.body2: Only company managers can see the records. Do not enter customer information. Photos and videos are saved in the company’s Google Drive. Do not film customers’ faces. Text written in other languages is sent to an external translation service (Anthropic) to be translated into Japanese.
privacy.body3: Records are used only inside the company and are not deleted.

home.installHint: Use "Add to Home Screen" on your phone to open this like an app.
home.welcome: Welcome back! Here is your shift today.
home.name: {{name}}
home.shiftRequestSub: Days and hours you can work next month
home.salesSub: End of shift: tickets, noodle check, cash
home.stockSub: Carry-over, deliveries, end count, fridge temperature
home.scheduleSub: My work days, times and store
home.testAccount: This is a test account. The manager screens are view-only; nothing can be changed. Its test records are deleted every day at 4:00 (Japan time); photos and videos are not uploaded.
home.manualSub: Order and way of each task
home.videosSub: Videos showing how to do it
home.absenceSub: Absent, late, leaving early / cover requests / attendance score
home.incidentSub: Record complaints, injuries, foreign objects, breakdowns at once
home.lostSub: Record, keep and return found items

phrase.maido: Thank you! (when taking the meal ticket, Osaka dialect)

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.network: No connection. Please try again where the signal is good.

attach.title: Photos & video
attach.limit: Up to 5 photos and 3 videos (90 s, 150 MB). They upload automatically after you send.
attach.tooLong: Videos can be up to 90 seconds.
attach.tooLarge: File too large (videos up to 150 MB).
attach.photoRequired: Please add at least 1 photo of the store.

upload.waiting: {{n}} file(s) waiting (will send when the signal is good)

fullName.title: Register your full name
fullName.body: Used for weekly and monthly reports. Enter your full name exactly as on your residence card or passport.
fullName.label: Full name
fullName.hint: e.g. 山田 太郎 / NGUYEN VAN AN
fullName.note: To correct your full name later, please contact a manager.

picker.empty: The staff list is empty. Please contact a manager.

translate.title: Check the translation
translate.body: Your text was translated into Japanese. Check that the meaning is right. You can edit the Japanese directly.
translate.editedNote: You edited the Japanese, so this check text was not updated.
translate.offline: Translation needs a connection. Please send again where the signal is good.

comment.title: Manager comments
comment.homeCard: You have {{n}} new comment(s) from a manager
comment.jaNote: A comment in another language is translated into Japanese before it is sent (you check it first).

incident.title: Complaints / accidents
incident.subtitle: Record it as soon as it happens. The managers get it.
incident.urgentHint: The managers get a mail at once. If it is urgent, also call.
incident.descriptionHint: Write freely in the language you know best. "Translate to Japanese with AI" below turns it into Japanese.
incident.action: What you did on the spot
incident.actionHint: e.g. made it again, refunded, first aid
incident.photoHint: Photos / videos of the situation (no customer faces)
incident.alreadyJapanese: It is already Japanese. No translation needed.
incident.customerHint: If you can, ask for the customer's name and phone number (so we can contact them later).
incident.actionFromAi: What you did (AI proposal, you can edit it)

contact.title: Contact a manager
contact.hint: If it is urgent, call or send a LINE right away. Contacting through these buttons is recorded.
contact.noContact: No contact has been set yet (Manager → Settings → Emergency contacts).
contact.lineHint: LINE opens. Choose {{name}} and send (the text is filled in).
contact.askPhone: Did you reach a manager by phone?
contact.askLine: Did you send the LINE to {{name}}?

ai.title: AI proposal
ai.hint: AI proposes what to do now, based on how managers handled earlier cases.
ai.needDescription: First choose the type and write what happened.
ai.failed: AI could not make a proposal
ai.noCases: No similar case yet, so these are general steps
ai.own: I did something else (write it yourself)

injured.title: Who was hurt
injured.onShiftHint: 🟢 = working the {{shift}} at this store now. Other staff below.

incident.lostMoved: Lost items have their own record

lost.title: Lost & found
lost.subtitle: Record a found item at once, and record it again when it is returned (a manager checks).
lost.adminSubtitle: Check and approve returns / police hand-overs. Comments are seen by all staff.
lost.descriptionHint: e.g. black folding umbrella, blue wallet (do not look inside)
lost.returnPhotoRule: When returning to a customer, a photo of the handover is required.
lost.askCustomerJa: お渡しするところを写真に撮ってもよろしいですか？お顔が写ってもよろしければ、お店の紹介（SNS・ホームページ）に使わせていただけますか？
lost.consentFace: The customer's face may be in the photo (customer agreed)
lost.consentMarketing: The photo may be used for the store's promotion (SNS, website) (customer agreed)
lost.faceOk: The face may be in the photo.
lost.faceNo: Without consent, do not show the customer's face (hands and item only).
lost.approvalHint: After saving, it waits for a manager’s approval.
lost.commentHint: All staff see it. Write the reason when sending back.
lost.rejectHint: Sent back = staff record it again.
lost.keptLong: Past the keep-until date (7 days; day {{n}}). Check whether to take it to the police.
lost.rejectedHint: A manager sent this back. Read the comment and record it again.
lost.marketingHint: Returns where the customer agreed to promotional use. Open a record for the photos.
lost.faceRuleOk: The customer agreed: their face may be in the photo (do not show other customers).
lost.doAwait: Waiting for the owner (they were reached)
lost.backToStored: Back to kept (they did not come)
lost.contactHint: Who contacted them and how, what they said…
lost.idConfirmed: I confirmed this is the owner
lost.idHint: Ask them to describe the colour, shape or contents first; hand it over when it matches.

wf.estimated: estimated: the found time (when it broke is unknown)
wf.estimatedNote: When it broke is unknown, so times count from when it was found.
wf.conflict: Someone updated it first. The latest version is loaded; please do it again.
wf.holdHint: What are you waiting for (parts, a repair visit…)?
wf.repairedHint: How it was fixed and the check result
wf.commentHint: What you checked, the situation… You can write in your language (translated to Japanese for you to check).
wf.safety: Urgent breakdown: do not use that equipment. Turn off power, gas or water if you can, keep customers and staff away, and call a manager now.
wf.occurredUnknown: If not, the time you found it is recorded.
wf.priorityHint: Urgent = affects service or safety now. High = should be fixed today.

dHow.firstResponse: From reported to taken by a manager
dHow.repair: From broken (or found) to the last repair (a repair that failed the check does not count)
dHow.complete: From broken (or found) to confirmed done
dHow.downtime: Not usable: broken → repaired, plus each rework → the next repair

stepHint.safety: The injured person is safe (first aid, ambulance…)
stepHint.isolated: The same product / ingredient is not used; serving stopped
